name: Progress-10
about: Progress-10 (1980-055A), a crewed vehicle (Progress), launched 1980 Jun 29. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1980 Jul  8), held fixed
docked to S10382; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
